schema.runs[]: {run, kind, arm, in_trees, n_sessions, n_aborted, output_cap_chars, command_cap_chars}
schema.sessions[]: {run, node, generation, parent, aborted, made_edit, player_changed, valid, files_edited[{path, role, added, removed}], practice_before, practice_after, gained[], lost[], n_steps, n_commands, n_nudges, n_gateway, coach_tokens, first_line, outcome_kind}
schema.gained/lost: practice tasks whose per-task score rose / fell vs the parent node (per-task scores are fractions of test inputs solved, pass@2)
schema.outcome_kind: 'no edit' (empty patch) | 'not scored' (aborted round or no score) | 'broke' (invalid or score 0) | 'improved' | 'same' | 'worse' (vs parent practice score)
schema.<run>.json: {run, sessions:{<node>:{steps:[{kind: brief|think|command|output|nudge|edit|done, text, cmd?, tool?, truncated?, full_chars?, trim?, has_scores?, n_traces?, ignored_calls?, from_echo?, collapsed_repeats?, empty?, raw?, after_call?, unparsed_call?, gateway?}], diff, diff_note?, aborted?}}}

notes: Aborted rounds (gen_<k>.aborted_<ts> dirs, restarted by the harness) that left a transcript are included with node '<k>.aborted_<ts>' and outcome 'not scored' (or 'no edit'). In all of them the coaching session finished; the harness stopped the round while the edited player was being scored (generate.log). Their parent is not recorded (parent=null). Aborted rounds stopped during coaching left no transcript and are not included (see excluded).
gained/lost are filled only for a scored edit (made_edit, not aborted, practice_after not null); no-edit and unscored nodes can carry a partial per_task.
player_changed=false with made_edit=true: only coach or other files changed, so the player is the parent's and any score change is re-evaluation noise.
valid mirrors trees.json node.valid (false: the harness did not accept the node as a parent).
Gateway replies (the model gateway answering '[GATEWAY] ... token budget ... exhausted' in place of a model reply) are 'nudge' steps with gateway=true, not coach messages.

Text the coach wrote after its executed tool call is a separate 'think' step with after_call=true, placed right after the command. Malformed or unrun tool calls stay in the text and set unparsed_call=true. Messages with no readable text are 'think' steps with empty=true (raw: the first 80 chars). Lone tag / brace fragments left by tool-call markup are dropped.
Local paths '/home/<user>/HyperAgents/' are replaced by '[local]/HyperAgents/' before any truncation.
Runs not in trees.json (smoke, trial_*) take scores from gen_<k>/arc_eval/report.json and have no coach_tokens.

'command' steps follow the harness's own tool-call detection (first valid <json> block, else a bare JSON object); ignored_calls counts further well-formed calls in the same message that the harness did not run.

Nudge steps with the harness's standard text are shortened to '(standard nudge) No tool call found; make the next tool call or reply DONE.'; full text: No tool call was found in your last response. If you are not finished, make the next tool call now, using exactly the <json> format above. If you are finished, reply with the single word DONE.
Harness lines such as 'Error: Output context exceeded' appear as 'nudge' steps prefixed '[harness]'.

Narration is never trimmed, except that degenerate token loops (a fragment or line repeated verbatim many times) are collapsed with a note and collapsed_repeats=true, and lone tag / brace lines are dropped.

Tool outputs keep head+tail; the brief's grid dumps are collapsed (inline grids, including answers, keep their first 120 chars) and failure traces share a ~2.4 KB budget (start and end of each kept); brief.trim says what was cut; narration ('think') is never trimmed.
To fit the 6 MB budget, tool outputs are capped at 1000 chars and commands at 1400 chars (head+tail; see truncated/full_chars on each step).
